name: Alana Stull
quote: From joining NSBE Jr. at 12 to serving as chapter president at Rice, this organization has been the constant thread through my engineering journey. It gave me a space to belong, mentors who shaped my career, and the confidence to lead myriad organizations, including my own startups at the intersection of design and engineering. Now, helping support the Duke chapter is my way of giving back to the community that invested so much in me.

name: Kennedy Achugamonu
quote: The NSBE mission and community have been amazing to be a part of, allowing me the opportunity to collaborate and learn from my likeminded peers.

name: Adalo Gusa
quote: Duke NSBE has been a welcoming community, support system, and safe space that shaped my first-year experience at Duke. As a Freshman Senator, I enjoyed learning how to build and maintain a successful student organization, and I can't wait to follow suit as a Programs Chair.

name: Ama Okyere
quote: The best place to build connections and lasting friendships while exploring engineering.

name: Izaiah Williams
major: Mechanical Engineering; Earth and Climate Sciences
quote: I have been an active NSBE member for 4 years now, and it has been one of the best academic decisions I have made. Through speaking with professionals, companies, and other students, I have found great support and guidance through my academic career, and I highly recommend participating to anyone even slightly interested in engineering.

name: Don Iwejuo
quote: NSBE has been a transformative part of my life. I joined the organization my junior year of high school, starting as the founder, and to become the President here at Duke makes me extremely grateful. NSBE has contributed massively to my personal and professional growth, which is why I am forever blessed to be part of it.

name: Hillary Ojeikere
quote: NSBE has provided me with the opportunity to forge meaningful connections with numerous individuals who have not only served as invaluable resources but have also emerged as impactful mentors.
